### 💡 Feature Idea
A clear and concise description of what the feature is and why it's valuable.

### ❓ Problem Solved
Describe the problem or limitation this feature solves (e.g. "Currently, there is no way to export Visitor details to CSV").

### 🎨 Proposed Solution / Implementation Mockup
Describe how you imagine this feature working or looking (add UI designs or component trees if possible).

### ⚡ Alternative Approaches
List any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### ➕ Additional Context
Add any other specifications, mock datasets, or links here.
